cohort: 422 neonates delivered at Debretabor General Hospital from July 1st, 2018, to June 30th, 2019.
finding: The proportion of neonates experiencing near miss was 32.2% (95% CI: 28%, 36%), and independent predictors included rural residence, incomplete ANC visit, primiparous, pregnancy-induced hypertension, premature rupture of membrane, cephalic-pelvic disproportion, and antepartum hemorrhage.
